attempts.prompt:
Create a production sprite atlas for a classic 16-bit snowball game. Use the attached Santa ONLY as a CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: friendly short plump man, round rosy nose, round dark eyes, fluffy white moustache and broad rounded beard, red hat flopping toward image right in the front view, white hat band, white gloves, red coat with white hem, black belt and square gold buckle, short black boots. Translate him into CLEAN LOW-RES PIXEL ART. NOT a textured rendering. ALL TWENTY FOUR poses must be the SAME Santa, same face, same hat, beard shape, body proportions, costume, scale, and palette. No switching character design between rows.

OUTPUT: one transparent sprite sheet, EXACTLY SIX equal-width columns and FOUR equal-height rows, 24 full-body Santa sprites, one per square cell, read left to right then top to bottom. Generous transparent margins in every cell. No text, numbers, grid lines, labels, backgrounds, scenery, shadows, glow, ground, or extra props.

PIXEL STYLE: hand-drawn console game sprite, bold readable pixel clusters designed for a 40-pixel-high on-screen character. Limited palette about 20 colors TOTAL across the sheet. Each material only 2 or 3 FLAT colors. Crisp clean dark navy one-native-pixel outline, simple flat red areas, warm ivory beard with one pale lavender shadow, simple peach face, navy black boots with one slate highlight. Very simple round face, bold friendly eyes. Absolutely NO dithering, grain, noise, stippling, fabric, hair strands, texture, gradients, translucent fringe, anti-aliasing, photographic rendering, tiny specks or isolated random pixels. Use large deliberate clean connected color blocks. Each intended native pixel rendered as a consistent solid square. No diagonal smooth vector lines. No checkerboard drawn in the image.

COMPOSITION: same scale in all cells, head/torso about 26 native pixels high, full height about 40. Standing soles share one baseline and belt one height. Hat and face retain same volume when turning. Whole figure fully visible. Use a proper coherent running gait with clear front/back leg alternation and steady torso; don't squash or stretch between frames.

Cell order (row-major, precisely 24):
ROW 1: six RUNNING poses facing image RIGHT, cycle phases 0 through 5: first right-boot contact with left leg behind; down/passing; push-off; airborne flight with separated feet; left-boot contact right leg behind; down/passing opposite.
ROW 2: cell1 running phase6 push-off opposite; cell2 running phase7 airborne opposite; cells3,4,5,6 TURNING poses progressively from right-facing three-quarter toward front (about 22,40,60,75 degrees toward viewer), small relaxed settling steps, same face and scale.
ROW 3: cells1,2,3,4 nearly FRONT-facing turn/settle poses, converging smoothly to both boots planted, arms relaxed, face toward viewer; cell5 FRONT neutral friendly smiling pose with one hand near cheek ready to greet; cell6 EXACT same pose with one eye closed in a wink.
ROW 4: cells1,2,3 FRONT WAVING to viewer: raised right hand on image left, open palm facing camera with visible fingers, shoulder and elbow fixed near ear level; only wrist tilts left, upright, right for a warm side-to-side greeting, other hand on belt. cells4,5,6 FRONT NOSE TWITCH: same body/head/boots as row3 neutral, both eyes open, hand near cheek, nose moved one native pixel left, center, one native pixel right. The small nose movement must be visible; rest of these three sprites identical.

Prioritize clean readable pixels and one coherent adorable Santa design over detail. True alpha transparent background.

Clean up this exact Santa sprite atlas for game export. Preserve the exact SIX columns by FOUR rows, the exact 24 poses, their cell positions, character scale, and same consistent Santa design. Keep all existing poses and silhouette sizes. IMPORTANT: remove ALL colored haze, gradients, dark red/gray backdrop, shadow, aura and semitransparent contamination between and around the sprites. True alpha ZERO in all empty space, fully OPAQUE flat colors inside each sprite. No ghost or semi-transparent full-sheet layer.

Make this MUCH CLEANER pixel art: approximately 20 solid flat palette colors, two or three tones per material maximum; large clean solid color clusters; consistent chunky square native pixels; sharply defined dark navy contour. Replace the fine grain in the red hat/coat, skin, beard and boots with flat solid colors. No dithering, speckles, grain, fabric texture, isolated dots or translucent fringe. No ground shadows, lights or magic. Do not soften. At native 40-pixel character height the Santa must read clearly with one consistent face throughout all 24 poses. Preserve exact ordered run, turn, peek, wink, three open-palm waves, and three tiny nose twitches. DO NOT add backdrop, text, labels, border or grid. Isolate only the 24 sprites on pure alpha transparency.

Convert this complete Santa animation sheet to authentic 8-BIT NES-ERA PIXEL ART for a low-res game. Preserve ALL 24 poses and the EXACT 6-column by 4-row grid and their order, but redraw EVERY sprite with much coarser intentional square pixels and very simple flat color clusters. Same Santa identity in every cell, same dimensions and belt level, friendly round face, hat droops image right in front views.

Use ONLY these EIGHT opaque colors, plus transparent: dark navy #171b2d, red #d82828, dark red #8c2030, warm white #fff4dc, pale gray #b8b8c8, peach #f4ac78, orange nose #e47858, gold #e8b840. No other colors. One native-pixel navy outline. No gradients or fine detail anywhere. Hat/coat use flat red with at most ONE dark red shape, beard/trim one warm white with ONE gray shape, face flat peach and orange nose, dot eyes navy. Black boots flat navy with one gray highlight. NO dithering, NO grain, NO noise, NO soft shading, NO antialiasing, NO texture. Each sprite should look like a hand-placed 32x40 pixel sprite enlarged with nearest neighbor, made of chunky square solid pixels, not a detailed illustration.

Critical: ACTUAL TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha 0). There must be NO COLORED BACKDROP OR GRADIENT, no haze, no sheet-wide translucent layer, NO shadows behind sprites, NO glow, NO floor. Every empty area including between arms and body alpha zero. Sprite interiors fully opaque. No text, no labels, no grid lines.

Keep 24 full bodies in separate equally sized cells with clear margins. Row1 run0-5 right-facing; Row2 run6-7 then four gradually turning poses toward viewer; Row3 four settling-front poses then neutral with hand by cheek and same pose winking; Row4 three open-palm wrist-only waves to viewer (same face and shoulder position), then three nose-twitch poses (same neutral body, nose left/center/right by one native pixel). Crucially unify running, greeting, waving and nose-twitching as the very same 8-bit Santa, not different renditions.
